company.name: Nova
company.shortDescription: Nova Product Development Services provide quality rapid prototyping services to a variety of clients.
company.description:
Nova Product Development Services Ltd. was established in 1993 to provide quality rapid prototyping (additive manufacturing) services to a variety of clients — designers, engineers, developers and the manufacturing industry. They offer their clients the most modern prototyping services available.

Rapid Prototyping (RP) processes include Polyjet printing, Stereolithography (SLA), Selective Laser Sintering (SLS), Fused Deposition Modeling (FDM), ZCorp, and Direct Metal Laser Sintering (DMLS) from manufacturers such as Objet, 3D Systems, Stratasys, and EOS.

productsAndServices.description: Creation of physical objects from 3D CAD models by building them layer by layer using additive manufacturing techniques.

productsAndServices.description: Production of small batches of parts or products, serving as an alternative to injection molding for low quantity runs.
